notes: The last eight Yerba Buena items of the Redevelopment Agency Records: Blight (SFH371-5055, 5056, 5057), Photos (5058, 5059), Contact Sheets (5060), New Start Center (5077) and Demolition (5078), read as 60-dpi contact sheets with every back that carries writing zoomed. People in the photographs are not transcribed.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in these eight items. Still unread in the collection: the A-2 appraisal and comparable-sales volumes, SFH371-5001 to 5038 (about 15,000 pages, 1960-1990).
coverage.note: 5057: seven typed labels dated 23 March 1964, five with a street number (findings 1-5; none has an EAS record) and two naming Tehama Street between Third and Fourth with no number. 5059 p. 3: comparable sale no. 18, 265-9 Third (finding 6); its other pages are undated 1970s appraisal views (St. Patrick's Church from Jessie Street, the St. James Hotel and the Williams Building at Third and Mission, a Fourth and Howard service station, a Fotomat kiosk site at Third and Stevenson, Golden State Mat Co. at 837) with no street number or date of their own. 5056: court-exhibit backs (Action 614067) for undated comparable sales, among them 1000 Brannan Street (Keystone Bros. leather) and 127 Second Street, and a 'Sale #3' of 4/61 with no address; Market Street Breakthrough views. 5055, 5058, 5060: street and interior photographs with negative numbers only. 5078: September 1968 demolition prints with block and lot only (3724). 5077, the New Start Center: portraits of displaced residents, some named on the backs; not read beyond identifying it, as with the Identified People items.

findings.description: The three-storey brick and wood-frame building on the lot, built in 1913 with three stores below two floors of 14 hotel rooms each, sold for $35,000.

raw.text: 265-9 Third Street ... Block 3735 Lot 16 ... Three-story brick and wood frame stores and rooms ... Built 1913 ... 28 rooms ... SALES PRICE $35,000.00 ... DEED DATED 7-20-61
raw.note: The grantors and the verifier are private individuals and are not transcribed.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 265 03RD ST → parcel 3735016; sf-parcels has blklot 3735016 active, 265–265 03RD; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use, a vacant commercial lot of 2,395 sq ft filed as 690 FOLSOM ST. The record's block 3735 lot 16 is the parcel, and its 30 x 80 ft, 2,400 sq ft lot matches the roll's area; the 1913 building is gone, so the fact is site history.
